Stable Story#000.src: I see you don't have any grain on you. Here, take these [{~} Wheat Grains] and use them to feed your new buddy.

Stable Story#001.src: I wish you luck in the horse training career, young friend! Make me and Betty proud!

Stable Story#002.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Well, lucky you! The wagon's been fixed up all nice and new!
Stable Story#002.dst: ¡Buenas! ¿Buscas quien te lleve a {p}? ¡Pues estás de suerte! ¡La carreta está arreglada y como nueva!

Stable Story#003.src: Just hop on aboard, and I'll get you to {p} in a jiffy!
Stable Story#003.dst: ¡Tú súbete y te llevo a {p} en un santiamén!

Stable Story#004.src: Ain't far to {p} from here! We'll be there in a jiffy, just you wait.
Stable Story#004.dst: ¡{p} no queda lejos de aquí! Llegaremos en un santiamén, ya verás.

Stable Story#005.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses- Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#005.dst: Normalmente pediría un buen precio por estos caballos- Sin ánimo de ofender, uno que tú no podrías pagar.

Stable Story#006.src: So, let's cut a deal- They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#006.dst: Así que hagamos un trato- Me robaron la llave del establo. Si puedes acercarte a mi establo en {p}...

Stable Story#007.src: And return that key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#007.dst: Y me devuelves esa llave, te concederé caritativamente uno de mis caballos. Además, el trato es mejor de lo que crees...

Stable Story#008.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah- who knows!? Life is full of mysteries, huh?
Stable Story#008.dst: Hm. ¿Vacas, eh? Ah- ¡¿quién sabe?! La vida está llena de misterios, ¿no?

Stable Story#009.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise on Betty I will-
Stable Story#009.dst: En fin. Pongo por testigo al gran bovino de las alturas: si veo el menor moratón en Betty, yo-

Stable Story#010.src: Ah! I can't just hand you a horse without telling you how to care for that beautiful creature, can I?
Stable Story#010.dst: ¡Ah! No puedo darte un caballo sin explicarte cómo cuidar de esa preciosa criatura, ¿verdad?

Stable Story#011.src: Those rich {p} folk have no respect for horses, let me tell you!
Stable Story#011.dst: ¡Esos ricachones de {p} no respetan a los caballos, te lo digo yo!

Stable Story#012.src: Now! Right Click the Feeder and place your [Horse Saddle] in there.
Stable Story#012.dst: ¡Bien! Haz clic derecho en el comedero y pon ahí tu [Horse Saddle].

Stable Story#013.src: Use the [{~} Wheat Grains] I gave you earlier to feed your new friend.
Stable Story#013.dst: Usa los [{~} Wheat Grains] que te di antes para alimentar a tu nuevo amigo.

Stable Story#014.src: Just Right Click the Feeder again.
Stable Story#014.dst: Haz clic derecho en el comedero otra vez.

Stable Story#015.src: Horses are sensitive creatures, you see. They don't grow strong over night, they require patience and a good stable diet.
Stable Story#015.dst: Los caballos son criaturas sensibles, ¿sabes? No se hacen fuertes en una noche: requieren paciencia y buena dieta.

Stable Story#016.src: However, you also need to take them out on walks so they get some well needed exercise, otherwise they will never reach their full potential.
Stable Story#016.dst: Pero también tienes que sacarlos a pasear para que hagan el ejercicio que necesitan; si no, nunca alcanzarán todo su potencial.

Stable Story#017.src: I almost forgot! If you really want to master the art of a horse trainer you can breed two horses using the Feeder.
Stable Story#017.dst: ¡Casi se me olvida! Si de verdad quieres dominar el arte de adiestrar caballos, puedes criar dos con el comedero.

Stable Story#018.src: Anyway! I wish you luck on your horse training career!
Stable Story#018.dst: ¡En fin! ¡Te deseo suerte en tu carrera de adiestrador de caballos!

Stable Story#019.dst: Habla con Enkser fuera de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#020.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#020.dst: ¡Busco aventureros fuertes! Preferiblemente sin amigos ni familia, ¡pero no soy exigente!
Stable Story#020.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#021.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#021.dst: Verás, soy tratante de caballos. Me gano la vida vendiendo estas preciosidades a aventureros como tú.
Stable Story#021.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#022.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#022.dst: Trabajo en este establo: vendo aquí los caballos que crío en {p} a los ricos de {p}.
Stable Story#022.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#023.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#023.dst: Hasta que esos alborotadores volaron un túnel bajo mi establo y se llevaron MIS caballos.
Stable Story#023.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#024.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#024.dst: Normalmente pediría un buen precio por estos caballos. Sin ánimo de ofender, uno que tú no podrías pagar.
Stable Story#024.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#025.src: So, let's cut a deal They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#025.dst: Así que hagamos un trato. Me robaron la llave del establo. Si puedes acercarte al mío en {p}...
Stable Story#025.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#026.src: And return the key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#026.dst: Y me devuelves la llave, te concederé caritativamente uno de mis caballos. Además, el trato es mejor de lo que crees...
Stable Story#026.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#027.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#027.dst: ¡Betty te ayudará! Es fuerte, ¡pero NI SE TE OCURRA dejar que la toquen!
Stable Story#027.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#028.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#028.dst: Yo mismo iré a {p} para asegurarme de que Betty esté a salvo.
Stable Story#028.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#029.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#029.dst: Venga, ponte en marcha. {p} está bastante más abajo por {p}, hacia el este.
Stable Story#029.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#030.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#030.dst: Lleva [{~} Stable Key] de vuelta a Enkser desde el túnel en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#031.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#031.dst: Oye, ¿ya has encontrado mi [{~} Stable Key]? Debería estar por {p}, al este.
Stable Story#031.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#032.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or
Stable Story#032.dst: Busco aventureros fuertes, preferiblemente sin amigos ni
Stable Story#032.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#033.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#033.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#034.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just lounged around.
Stable Story#034.dst: Ah, bendito sea. Y supongo que Betty hizo todo el trabajo mientras tú holgazaneabas.
Stable Story#034.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#035.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah who knows!? Life is full of mysterious, huh?
Stable Story#035.dst: Hm. ¿Vacas, eh? ¡¿Quién sabe?! La vida está llena de misterios, ¿no?
Stable Story#035.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#036.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise I will
Stable Story#036.dst: En fin. Pongo por testigo al gran bovino de las alturas: si veo el menor moratón, yo
Stable Story#036.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#037.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#037.dst: Olvida todo eso. Un caballo te prometí y un caballo tendrás. Muchísimas gracias.
Stable Story#037.speaker: Enkser
